caption: The drawing depicts the head and upper neck of a horse sculpted object, rendered in shades of dark gray and black. The horse’s head is detailed with a pronounced ear, eye, nostril, and mouth. A smooth metal ring passes through the horse’s mouth, hanging vertically. The mane is short and follows the contour of the neck, with stylized, slightly raised sections. The horse’s head transitions into a cylindrical base, also shaded in gray and black, ending in an uncolored, unfinished lower section that contrasts with the detailed rendering above. The background is a plain off-white, with no additional objects or scenery present in the composition.
title: Hitching Post
